base_eval_set: Warm fixed-test rows with at least max(k) same-artist train-history rows

warm_lite_training.group_stats: k-truncated train, 5-fold internal stats for train rows, full train_k stats for test rows
warm_lite_training.quantile_models: LightGBM Quantile q10/q50/q90 full + q50 lean retrained per seed/k
warm_lite_training.residual_model: LightGBM objective=huber residual retrained per seed/k from OOF Quantile residual

warm_training.svc_axis: comparable-stat Huber retrained per seed/k with artist min_n=1
warm_training.sequential_axis: CatBoost Quantile -> Huber -> CatBoost residual generated-bucket stack retrained per seed/k
warm_training.refit: Huber residual refit trained on warm validation per seed/k
warm_training.router: risk threshold q50 learned from warm validation per seed/k, gap=0.005

limitations: This is a condition-retrained clean stack comparison, not an exact historical WMIN8/PPV8 full artifact rebuild.
Warm-lite k=5~6 remains outside the official Warm-lite route and is included as a stress comparison.
The same-n main table excludes rows that cannot support all k values.
